items.title: Bobby Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Shall we pause for a minute, Tim?

ctx.x: Yes I did. In public school and then I went for a couple of years to college, and then learned a little bit about harmony and theory and things like that.
Shall we pause for a minute, Tim? First we had someone pounding on a porch over here. Marty is a great character.
